input.quality_summary: Merged PR that adds Circle Onramp Kit integration to the Arc fintech dashboard, enabling fiat-to-crypto purchases directly into developer-controlled wallets. Changes include environment configuration, documentation updates, and webhook setup for onramp deposit settlement.
reasons: Adds meaningful capability: onramp feature enables real user workflow (fiat-to-crypto) on Circle's platform
Properly scoped: focused integration with clear sandbox/production separation and security guidance (private key handling in ~/.npmrc)
Good documentation: README updates explain the feature, prerequisites, and environment setup clearly
Webhook integration documented: explains how onramp.deposit.settled events are handled and where to enable them in Circle Console
Configuration is defensive: explicit warnings about sandbox vs production endpoints and consequences of misconfiguration

Minor quality gap: submission shows only file diffs without full context of implementation code (onramp session endpoint, UI components, event handlers) — cannot fully assess code readability or completeness of the feature
